title: Other Vehicle Documents and Temporary For-Hire Permit Acceptance: Cases
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, a Wayfare driver's other vehicle documents bear on the temporary permit acceptance days, the calendar days from the upload day for which a temporary for-hire permit is accepted as the for-hire permit on file.

## Rule

Counting the auto insurance and the vehicle inspection by their expiry dates on the agreement, and the vehicle registration by the expiry date on its latest upload, each whose expiry date lies fewer than 30 calendar days after the upload day, or is already past, is a short document; with two or more short documents the temporary permit acceptance days change by -12 days, with exactly one they change by -6 days, and with none they do not change.

| Short documents among the three | Change |
|---|---|
| two or three | -12 |
| exactly one | -6 |
| none | 0 |

A document whose expiry date lies 30 days or more after the upload day is not short.

## Cases (hypothetical, upload day 2026-09-05)

**Case 1.** Auto insurance on the agreement expires 2026-10-04 (29 days after: short). Inspection on the agreement expires 2027-03-01 (not short). Latest registration upload expires 2026-10-05 (30 days after: not short). One short document: -6.

**Case 2.** Auto insurance expires 2027-01-15 (not short). Inspection on the agreement expired 2026-08-30 (past: short). Latest registration upload expired 2026-09-01 (past: short). Two short documents: -12.

**Case 3.** All three expire in 2027. No short document: no change.
